messages:
emma: Customer (Acme Corp, org_9876) raised an EU residency + erasure request. They want confirmation that audit logs, backups, and any personal data for EU users are stored in EU only, plus proof of deletion for the last 6 months. Also asked whether encryption keys are managed by Redwood or an HSM. Can someone advise next steps? :eyes:

raj: Can you paste the org id and requester's email? Hosted or Dedicated/Private? Any legal hold flagged?

emma: Hosted. Org: org_9876. Requester: data-request@acme.com. No legal hold mentioned in the ticket. They explicitly invoked GDPR right to erasure and want timestamps + a signed statement.

sofia-security: Short answer: for Hosted EU orgs we store primary audit logs in the org's configured EU region (eg eu-west-1). We have cross-region DR replication to eu-central-1 only for a small subset of shards. Backups are encrypted at rest. Keys: Hosted uses Redwood-managed CMKs (AWS KMS) by default. HSM-backed (BYOK/HSM) is only available for Private/Dedicated with customer-managed keys.

lena-legal: Before we proceed, we must verify the requestor's authority. For erasure we need an org admin confirmation or signed consent from the user(s). Also confirm scope: "personal data" vs "logs referencing users" vs "full account data."

raj: Suggested support flow: 1) Verify requester identity & admin approval. 2) Create internal ticket (sec+infra+legal) with org id, requester email, requested time range. 3) Run audit export for the time range and attach to ticket. 4) If approved, schedule deletion job and prepare the deletion statement.

emma: I ran a quick audit export to estimate scope. Sample query I used from console: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/logs?org=org_9876&start=2024-09-01&end=2025-03-01&filter=user_email"
```
Result: ~4.2k events matching. I'll attach the export to the ticket after we get admin confirmation.

sofia-security: Note on what we can prove: we provide an export of affected records + a signed deletion confirmation. Primary data deletion is performed promptly after approval. Backup shards and snapshots are on a 30-day expiration schedule — physical/replication copies may be removed asynchronously and we state that in the proof ("primary data purged, backups expunged within 30 days"). For KMS: we can provide CloudTrail extracts showing which CMK IDs were used against the org's buckets. If the customer needs cryptographic key destruction proof (HSM key zeroization), that is only possible for Private customers with their own HSM.

emma: The customer also asked for KMS usage logs keyed to org activity. Can we provide that?

sofia-security: Yes — we can produce a limited CloudTrail extract showing key IDs and operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) scoped to the bucket/key ARNs and time range. We'll redact any unrelated orgs. Attach to ticket: request infra to pull CloudTrail signed export.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-2025-3124 (sec+infra+legal) — assigned to sofia-security, raj.

lena-legal: I'll prepare the GDPR erasure response template and the language for the deletion statement (including standard wording about backups and KMS). Emma, please confirm whether the customer asked for immediate erasure or just confirmation of residency first.

emma: Confirmed — they asked for erasure of personal data for EU users in the specified window. I'll reply asking for org admin approval and attach the audit sample. /cc @sofia-security

sofia-security: :thumbsup: Once we receive admin confirmation we'll queue infra to run the deletion job and pull CloudTrail artifacts. If they insist on HSM-level crypto proof, we should propose Private (BYOK/HSM) as the long-term option.

emma: On it. I'll update ticket #SUP-2025-3124 with the requester's confirmation steps and the audit export.

raj: Thanks — keep me posted if Legal needs additional scope or if infra finds cross-region copies outside EU.

sofia-security: FYI: internal playbook links added to the ticket (redwood.internal/playbooks/gdpr-erasure and /playbooks/kms-audit).

emma: Closing loop here — will update after admin confirmation arrives.
